name: railing
description: Railing/balustrade (护栏/栏杆): six kinds from one generator — fence (wooden balustrade), wall (cobblestone/stone-brick wall blocks, chunky castle/bridge look), pane (glass_pane/iron_bars infill between posts), trapdoor (vertical OPEN trapdoors = panel balustrade), stair_rail (handrail stepping along a stair slope, one post per step, stair facing = uphill per the iron rule), bridge (deck + rails on both long edges + optional abutment piers). L-corners via the corner param; pane corners and run ends get anchor posts. All direction states (trapdoor facing/open, stair facing) are DERIVED from origin+facing.
when_to_use: Any edge that needs guarding or a finished lip: balcony/terrace edges, stair flights (stair_rail), bridges (bridge), roof decks, garden fences, dock edges. origin = the FIRST cell of the run, y = the layer the railing stands in (the cell ABOVE the deck/floor for edge rails; for stair_rail, the first step's cell). facing = the direction the run GOES (origin -> far end; for stair_rail: uphill). DIRECTION STATES ARE DERIVED BY THE SCRIPT — never hand-edit (禁止手改方向状态).
use_for: 阳台/露台/桥/楼梯扶手/屋面平台/花园围栏边缘收边;木民居 fence,石构/城堡 wall,现代/采光 pane,木面板式 trapdoor

kind.notes: 做法大类;见 kinds 节

origin.notes: 首格(栏杆所在层,即甲板/地面上一格);stair_rail 为第一步踏板格

facing.notes: 栏杆走向(origin->远端);stair_rail=上坡方向

material.notes: 按 kind 校验后缀:fence=*_fence, wall=*_wall, pane=*_pane|iron_bars, trapdoor=*_trapdoor, stair_rail=扶手柱(*_fence|*_wall), bridge=栏杆条

height.notes: 栏杆高(fence/wall/pane/trapdoor);2 层 pane=落地玻璃栏板

outward.notes: trapdoor 面板朝向(铰链+面板所在侧);auto=走向右侧;只影响 trapdoor

corner.notes: 远端 L 型拐弯;拐弯处 pane 自动加锚柱,trapdoor 第二段 outward 自动换向

corner_length.notes: 拐弯段长度(不含转角格)

post_material.notes: pane 锚柱/bridge 角柱;可用 *_log 做粗柱

post_spacing.notes: pane 每隔几格一根柱(首尾与转角恒有柱)

step_material.notes: stair_rail 的梯段;facing=上坡(铁律,脚本推导)

with_steps.notes: stair_rail:false=只发扶手柱(架在已有梯段上;验收时 support_check 需传 base=梯段文件)

pier_drop.notes: 桥墩下探层数(须到地面/水面下)

fence.recipe: 一排栅栏(1-2 高),自动连接成栏;转角靠 MC 自动连接,拐角格即转角。
pitfalls: 栅栏别和 wall 混排(视觉粗细突变);要转角柱加粗用 post_material 的思路:另放 log 柱

wall.recipe: 一排墙块(cobblestone_wall/stone_brick_wall),粗壮压边,适合石桥/城堡/基座缘。
pitfalls: wall 块顶面可站人但别当 walkway;与 fence 衔接处会断开一截,交接处用整砖柱过渡

pane.recipe: 玻璃板/铁栏杆填充,首尾+每 post_spacing 格+转角一根 post_material 锚柱。
pitfalls: pane 没有柱锚就像飘带,首尾必须有柱;铁栏杆(iron_bars)配石构,玻璃板配现代

trapdoor.recipe: 立起的开活板门(open=true)一排,铰链/面板在 outward 侧,读作木面板栏板。
pitfalls: open 必须 true,closed 是躺板不是栏杆;outward 给反了面板就贴在甲板内侧;高度 1 层就够,2 层像墙

stair_rail.recipe: 梯段每步升 1 格(楼梯 facing=上坡,铁律),每步踏板上立一根扶手柱。
pitfalls: 扶手柱必须落在每步踏板正上方,别悬在两级之间;光滑坡道扶手别用整条斜线(做不到),踏步柱就是正解;坡顶/坡底平台要接一段平栏杆(另调本卡 kind=fence)

bridge.recipe: 甲板(宽 width)+两长边栏杆(v=1)+四角锚柱(fence/wall 栏杆时)+两端桥墩。
pitfalls: 栏杆在甲板边缘格的正上方,不占走道;桥墩 pier_drop 必须触地,水面桥墩要伸进水里;width=1 的独木桥别加栏杆(没地方站)
栏杆放'甲板边缘格的正上方一格',不是悬空贴在甲板外侧面——贴外侧那一列会浮空且玩家走不出去
trapdoor 栏杆 open=true 才立得住面板;facing=面板所在侧(outward),给反了栏板贴到内侧
stair_rail 楼梯 facing=上坡方向(stair_orientations.md 铁律),扶手柱在每步踏板正上方
转角处理:fence/wall 靠自动连接(拐角格共用),pane 必须在转角放锚柱,trapdoor 拐角段 outward 要换向(脚本已推导)
pane 首尾无柱是大忌;高度 2 的 pane 只用于现代落地栏板
本卡只管栏杆本体;阳台整体(甲板+支撑+栏杆)用 balcony 卡
验收:输出必须过 support_check(桥墩/梯段提供支撑路径);stair_rail 过 stair_corner_check
example: python patterns/railing.py --params '{"kind":"fence","origin":[100,64,100],"facing":"east","length":6,"corner":"right"}' --out rail.json && python patterns/railing.py --params '{"kind":"stair_rail","origin":[100,64,120],"facing":"north","length":5,"step_material":"minecraft:stone_brick_stairs","material":"minecraft:cobblestone_wall"}' --out stair_rail.json && python patterns/railing.py --params '{"kind":"bridge","origin":[100,64,140],"facing":"south","length":8,"width":3,"rail":"pane","material":"minecraft:glass_pane"}' --out bridge.json
